name: FileBot
post_parameters: /media/odottaa --output /media --action move --lang fi --conflict skip -non-strict --log-file /data/amc.log --def unsorted=y music=n artwork=n extractFolder=/puretut deleteAfterExtract=y clean=y skipExtract=n excludeList=/data/amc.excludes "movieFormat=leffat/{n.colon(' - ')} ({y})/{n.colon(' - ')} ({y}){subt}" "seriesFormat=sarjat/{n.colon(' - ')}/Season {s.pad(2)}/{n.colon(' - ')} - {s00e00} - {t.colon(' - ')}{subt}"
description: Automatic media organizer: watches <media>/odottaa, extracts RAR releases, identifies movies and TV episodes (TMDB/TheTVDB, Finnish titles) and moves them into leffat/ and sarjat/ (never overwrites). Requires a FileBot license: copy the .psm file to the appdata folder as license.psm and run once: docker exec FileBot filebot --license /data/license.psm

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Media root: input odottaa/, output leffat/ and sarjat/

variables.name: SETTLE_DOWN_TIME
variables.description: Seconds since last change before processing (skips unfinished downloads)
